title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statement: Merge two sorted linked lists and return it as a sorted list.

mistakes.hint1: Check the comparison between the nodes of the two lists.
mistakes.hint2: Are you picking the smaller value first?
mistakes.hint3: Make sure your greater-than/less-than signs are correct.

mistakes.hint1: Make sure you aren't accidentally moving your pointer forward twice.
mistakes.hint2: Are you forgetting to link a node before moving?
mistakes.hint3: Trace your pointers carefully on a piece of paper.
mistakes.hint4: Only advance the pointer of the list you just pulled a node from.

mistakes.hint1: What happens if one of the linked lists is completely empty from the start?
mistakes.hint2: If list A is empty, the merged list is just list B. Does your code handle this?
mistakes.hint3: Check for `if (list1 == NULL)` right at the beginning of your function.
mistakes.hint4: Your main loop condition should be `while (list1 != NULL && list2 != NULL)`.

mistakes.hint1: If both lists have a node with the same value, what do you do?
mistakes.hint2: You need to include BOTH of them in the merged list. Don't skip one.
mistakes.hint3: Are you advancing both pointers when values are equal?
mistakes.hint4: When `val1 == val2`, pick one, link it, and ONLY move that specific list's pointer.

mistakes.hint1: One list might run out of nodes before the other.
mistakes.hint2: When the `while` loop ends, one of the lists might still have elements.
mistakes.hint3: Are you appending the rest of the longer list at the end of your merged list?
mistakes.hint4: After the loop, simply link the remaining list: `current->next = (list1 != NULL) ? list1 : list2;`.

mistakes.hint1: It looks like one of your pointers isn't moving forward inside the loop.
mistakes.hint2: This causes the loop to run forever.
mistakes.hint4: Ensure every branch of your if/else updates a pointer.

mistakes.hint1: You can't just attach list B to the end of list A.
mistakes.hint2: You have to weave them together so the final list remains sorted.
mistakes.hint4: Create a dummy head node and iteratively attach the smallest node.
